issue_request: FHIR-28432 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 by the CDS work group. It requested subject[x] support for MedicinalProductDefinition and SubstanceDefinition for PQ/CMC quality specifications, and the final resolution expanded the documented product-definition targets to MedicinalProductDefinition, SubstanceDefinition, AdministrableProductDefinition, ManufacturedItemDefinition, and PackagedProductDefinition while adding a canonical subject choice for definitional subjects.
initial_application: Jira comments link HL7/fhir#1043, #1054, and the R4B application in #1134. Local history shows ae9498546d initially added product-definition subject support in spreadsheet source, 86008a3206 constrained PlanDefinition.subject canonical targets to the five product-definition resources, and 55174ee020 re-applied those targets to the R4B StructureDefinition after a temporary tooling-related backout.
additional_context: PlanDefinition is active and approved in source/fhir.ini. Later FHIR-37485 found that the product-definition resources are not all canonical resources, so 3cef25612a moved them from PlanDefinition.subjectCanonical to subjectReference and left canonical limited to EvidenceVariable; an existing FHIR-37485 reconciliation commit aligned the remaining prose and mirrored source metadata.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source change is needed because source/plandefinition/structuredefinition-PlanDefinition.xml already lists Reference(Group, MedicinalProductDefinition, SubstanceDefinition, AdministrableProductDefinition, ManufacturedItemDefinition, PackagedProductDefinition) for PlanDefinition.subject[x], includes canonical(EvidenceVariable), and documents the product-definition use case without stale subjectCanonical wording.
